title: Backend compare preview endpoint
description: Add trusted backend preview for MISSING/MISMATCH manual adjustment records before running Auto Key-In.
convergence: Endpoint accepts period, division, category, and optional gang/employee scope.
Endpoint filters compare/check results to MISSING/MISMATCH only.
Response records are compatible with Auto Key In ManualAdjustmentRecord.
API keys and Plantware credentials stay server-side.
